findings.evidence: PR lines 91, 97, 104, and 136 use only `@[reassoc]`; Mathlib has `attribute ... (attr := reassoc (attr := simp)) IsMonHom.one_hom IsMonHom.mul_hom` and `@[to_additive (attr := reassoc (attr := simp))] theorem inv_hom`.
findings.fix: Annotate these lemmas as `@[reassoc (attr := simp)]` or `@[simp, reassoc]`, matching the underlying Mathlib API where `IsMonHom.one_hom`, `IsMonHom.mul_hom`, and `GrpObj.inv_hom` are simp-normalization lemmas.
findings.issue: `Hom.one_hom`, `Hom.mul_hom`, `Hom.inv_hom`, and `Hom.toSchemeHom_comp_hom` are characteristic preservation/base-compatibility lemmas but are only `@[reassoc]`, so the abelian-variety API does not expose them as normal-form simp lemmas.

summary: The morphism surface is appropriately narrow, but several characteristic homomorphism lemmas are exposed without the normal-form automation attributes users need downstream.
